batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b JO Holder

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b R Ashwin

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c Avesh Khan b MP Stoinis

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c Ravi Bishnoi b MP Stoinis

batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c N Pooran b Avesh Khan

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b Avesh Khan

batting.name: Dhruv Jurel
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hooda b Avesh Khan

balls.text: length delivery on off stump. Yudhvir swings at it and shanks it towards deep square leg. They go for the second because, well, why not, and Yudhvir is at least a couple of yards short at the batter's end!

bulls-eye! Length delivery just outside off stump. Pandya swings at it and misses comfortably. Pooran, though, calls him through for the bye. Samson does well to gather it on the bounce and with the glove on, shies at the batter's end, catching Pooran well short of his ground!
edged and four! Full and outside off stump. Pandya throws his hands at it and slices it over short third man for a boundary!

edged and taken! Short and wide outside off stump, and this seems to take Stoinis by surprise. He has a hack across the line but Stoinis can only feather it through to the keeper. Sandeep is elated, and he should be! He has bowled a brilliant over so far!
full delivery outside off stump. Pooran drills it straight back to the bowler, who gets something behind it and deflects it towards long off. Just a single
back of a length delivery way outside off stump. Pooran shuffles across his stumps and drags it towards deep mid wicket. The fielder fumbles a little and the batters get across for a brace
low full toss outside off stump. Stoinis sits deep in his crease and shanks it towards long on for a couple of runs. 17 runs off that over!
yorker outside off stump. Pooran opens his bat face and guides it down to deep backward point. That fielder was in the circle on the previous ball
punished! Low full toss outside off stump. Pooran throws his hands at it and slices it over backward point for another boundary!
full toss sprayed outside off stump. Pooran has a massive swing at it but only connects with the fresh Jaipur air
four more! Full and down the leg side again. Pooran waits for the ball to arrive before glancing it neatly past short fine leg!
Pooran breaks free! Length delivery slanted into leg stump. Pooran uses the angle, gets inside the line and heaves it over the deep backward square leg fence!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Pooran goes back and pushes it into the off side for a single
safe! Full delivery outside off stump. Pooran advances and throws his hands at it. He slices it badly but luckily for him, he evades long off
very full delivery fired into the pads. Stoinis flicks it towards deep mid wicket for one more run
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Pooran comes forward and eases it towards long off for just another single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Stoinis knocks it down the ground for a single
full delivery that pitches outside leg stump. Stoinis tries the reverse sweep but misses as the ball hits the pads
yorker on leg stump. Pooran uses the pace on offer and tucks it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs
very full delivery on off stump. Pooran advances and throws his bat at it but ends up shanking it back towards the bowler
short delivery outside off stump. Stoinis gets onto the back foot and laces his pull to deep mid wicket. Just a single, though
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Stoinis has a nibble at it and is beaten as the ball seems to seam past the outside edge
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Stoinis stands up tall on the back foot and crunches it past extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Pooran opens up his stance and heaves it towards deep square leg for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Stoinis nudges it into the leg side and scampers back for a brace
full delivery darted into the pads. Pooran gets inside the line of the ball and works it behind square on the leg side
slower delivery on a full length on off stump. Stoinis comes forward and flicks it towards long on for one
back of a length delivery on off stump. Pooran has a poke at it and gets an inside edge that deflects off his pads into the off side
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that zips through. Pooran has a waft at it but is late on the stroke as the ball nips past the outside edge
length delivery angled into leg stump. Stoinis lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep square leg
length delivery on middle and off stump. Stoinis waits in his crease and eases it down the ground for a single
slowed up on a length on middle and off stump. Pooran drops it into the off side and gets across to the other end
length delivery down the leg side. Pooran gets down on one knee and paddles it straight to the fielder at short fine leg
tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Stoinis reaches out for it and drills it towards long off for one
full delivery just outside off stump. Pooran stretches forward and pushes it towards long off for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Stoinis goes back and knocks it down the ground for a single
full delivery on middle and off stump. Pooran comes forward and flicks it straight into his front boot

Ashwin has two! Length delivery fired into middle and off stump. Mayers does not go forward neither does he go back and is stranded in his crease. He has a stab at it but the ball breezes past the bat before smashing into middle and off stump! Ashwin is elated, and LSG are sliding further into trouble!
full delivery on leg stump. Stoinis gives himself a bit of room and works it into the leg side for a single
clever! Full delivery on middle and off stump. Stoinis brings out the reverse-paddle first up and fetches himself a boundary past short third man!

taken by Hetmyer on the fence! Flighted slightly on a length on leg stump from around the wicket, and Hooda is enticed into a massive slog. He swings mightily but does not get the contact he desires. It goes miles up into the air towards deep square leg, where Hetmyer covers some ground to his right before holding onto the chance!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayers stabs it off the inner half of the bat into the on side for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point. Gets to his fifty too, off 40 balls!
four more! Dragged down outside leg stump. Mayers picks the length early, rocks back and smashes it past deep mid wicket
shot! In the slot outside off stump. Mayers gets to the pitch of the ball and crashes it over extra cover for a much-needed boundary!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Dabbed straight to backward point
in the air, but it falls in no man's land! Length delivery on leg stump that holds in the surface. Mayers swipes and miscues it badly. So badly that it does not even cross the 30-yard circle
length delivery down the leg side. Hooda glances it down to deep backward square leg and collects a single
full delivery angled into off stump. Hooda plants his front foot and drives it crisply past the bowler for a single
full delivery just outside off stump. Hooda comes half forward and pokes it off the outer half of the bat towards backward point

leg stump flat on the ground! Length delivery outside off stump. Badoni walks across his stumps and takes the cheeky option. Gets into position for the scoop but only ends up deflecting it straight into leg stump! Boult has his first, and the Badoni experiment is cut short!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that skids through. Badoni has a waft at it but is beaten on the inside
full delivery angled into leg stump. Mayers has another hack at it and misses as the ball trickles off the back leg into the off side
full delivery just outside off stump. Badoni comes forward and flicks it down the ground to get off the mark
full delivery on middle and off stump. Mayers gets onto the front foot and defends it towards short extra cover

length delivery angled into off stump. Badoni comes down the track and then plays all over it as the ball pings off the pads into the off side. Holder appeals for the lbw but that is always going over the top of the stumps

straight to long on! Full delivery just outside off stump. Rahul plants his front foot and looks to go downtown. At the last moment, though, he seems to hold back and does not go through with his bat swing. Gets decent contact but because he checked his stroke, he can only arrow it straight down Buttler's throat!
low full toss on middle and off stump. Mayers gets his front foot out of the way and powers it down the ground towards long off
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rahul stabs it down the ground for another single
length delivery slanted into the stumps. Mayers has a slog at it and drags it towards deep backward square leg
length delivery darted into middle and leg stump. Mayers chips it over the bowler and ambles across to the other end
length delivery fired outside off stump. Mayers goes feeling for it and chops it towards the keeepr
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul goes back and jabs it towards long on for another single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Mayers knocks it down the ground for one more run
back of a length delivery way outside off stump. Mayers swishes and misses. The umpire calls it a wide
length delivery on middle and off stump. Mayers punches it towards short extra cover
length delivery on leg stump. Rahul pushes it into the leg side and canters across to the other end
full delivery on off stump. Rahul lunges forward and drives it down the ground for a single
into the stands! In the slot at the stumps, and Rahul capitalises! Gets down on one knee and smacks it well over the deep mid wicket fence! 103-metre six!
length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul is stuck on the crease and pokes it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mayers goes back and across before punching it towards deep cover point
four more! Full delivery fired down the leg side. Mayers gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it past fine past the keeper
lovely! Flighted on a full length on middle and off stump. Mayers dances down the track and eases it over the long off fence!
four more! Dug into the track outside off stump and that is easy pickings for Rahul. He waits in his crease and hammers it over mid wicket!
very full delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayers advances and flicks it towards long on for one
shot! Slower delivery on middle and leg stump that sits up to be hit. Mayers gives himself plenty of room and slaps it over mid off for six!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rahul gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point for a single
length delivery on leg stump. Mayers has another wild slog at it and misses as the ball trickles off the thigh pad into the off side
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mayers swipes at it but does not make much contact as the ball pings off the pads towards the bowler
slider on a back of a length outside off stump. Rahul cuts it towards backward point, where the fielder misfields and ends up conceding a couple of runs
tossed up on a length just outside off stump. Rahul comes forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
another googly on a full length on off stump. Mayers opens his bat face and dabs it down to short third man for a single
googly on a full length on middle and off stump. Mayers lunges forward and prods it into the off side
short delivery outside off stump that comes off very slowly. Rahul has a slog at it and squirts it down to short fine leg
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul waits in his crease and works it towards deep mid wicket
length delivery on middle and off stump. Rahul goes back and knocks it down the ground for a single
gets it away! Full and fired down the leg side. Rahul uses the pace on offer and helps it over short fine leg for a much-needed boundary!
length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul lunges forward and pushes it towards cover point
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul pats it back to the bowler

is that out? It could be very close! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Rahul backs away and punches it towards cover point. There is a bit of hesitation between the two batters with Mayers eventually having to rush back to make his ground at the bowler's end. Ashwin, though, might have inadvertently flicked off the bails before the ball got there. Mayers might have made his ground anyway, and he survives!
length delivery fired into middle and leg stump. Mayers goes back and punches it down the ground for a single

Rahul has been dropped again, would you believe it?! Full delivery just outside off stump that might have held in the surface. Rahul mistimes his attempted lofted shot and it spoons up towards mid off. Holder runs back, gets both hands to it but can't hold on
edged and four! Length delivery outside off stump. Rahul throws the kitchen sink at it and flashes it past Samson for a boundary!
full toss angled into the batter's pads. Mayers misses it altogether as the ball pings off the pads towards short third man for a leg bye

back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Mayers continues swinging and jams it into his body. That might have pined him on the inner part of the knee. If that is the case, it might sting for a bit!
breaks the shackles! Full and darted into the stumps. Mayers gives himself just enough room to free his arms and flay it over cover for six!
full and angled into leg stump. Mayers backs away and looks to go over mid on but ends up mistiming it towards that fielder
low full toss on off stump. Mayers hacks it away towards deep square leg for one more run

missed run out chance now! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rahul bunts it towards short extra cover and sets off for the single. Jaiswal has a shy at the bowler's end and misses. Rahul was well out of his crease had he hit
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Rahul chops it back towards the keeper
slower delivery on a full length on middle and leg stump. Mayers pokes it towards mid off and ambles across to the other end
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul comes forward and pushes it past the bowler for a single
dropped, oh dear! Full delivery on off stump. Rahul takes a step down the track and drives it straight to extra cover, where Jaiswal puts down an absolute sitter. How costly could that be?
oh! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers has a swipe across the line and only connects with fresh air
full delivery on middle and off stump. Mayers comes onto the front foot and blocks it towards mid off
length delivery angled into leg stump. Mayers is tucked up for room and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers gets into position and taps it into the off side
full delivery just outside off stump. Mayers has another waft at it and chunks it off the inner half of the bat past short mid wicket for a brace
full delivery just outside off stump. Mayers looks for the expansive straight drive but can only shank it towards mid on
shot! Full delivery outside off stump. Rahul plants his front foot, opens his bat face at the last moment and threads it past cover point for four!
length delivery outside off stump. Rahul takes a step down the track and flicks it past short mid wicket for a couple of runs
full delivery just outside off stump. Mayers tips the ball down the ground before scrambling across to the other end
very full delivery outside off stump. Mayers hangs back in his crease and guides it straight to the fielder at backward point
full delivery on leg stump that swings in late. Mayers plays all over it and is pinned on the pads. Going down leg, though. Oh dear, looks like Sandeep has overstepped!

edged and four! Full delivery outside off stump. Mayers throws his hands at it and slices it towards third man. Boult comes in from the fence, goes for the catch but does not make it. The ball beats his dive and bounces away for four
full delivery just outside off stump. Mayers gets onto the front foot and defends into the off side
length delivery on middle and leg stump that curves into the batter. Rahul dangles his bat and gets an inside edge before the ball strikes the pads.Maiden to start off the innings!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Rahul lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rahul gets up on his toes and drops it into the on side towards short mid wicket
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul waits in his crease and pushes it towards extra cover
length delivery on off stump that shapes into Rahul a touch. He comes half forward and defends into the off side
length delivery in the channel just outside off stump that pitches and holds its line. Rahul has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up

LSG win by 10 runs! Back of a length delivery on off stump. Ashwin smashes it towards deep mid wicket where Bishnoi puts down the catch. LSG, though, will not even care about it. They have been superb in the field, and they have come to the home of the table-toppers and toppled them!
full delivery on off stump. Ashwin clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs

taken expertly at long on by Hooda! Full delivery just outside off stump. Jurel sits deep in his crease and clubs it towards long on. Hooda judges it to perfection, times his jump beautifully and then holds onto the chance. Excellent balance on display too, and RR are on the brink now!

edged and taken! Avesh with a crucial, crucial wicket! Full and sprayed well outside off stump. Padikkal, because of the field, tries to slice it over the in-field. He does not get into a good enough position, though, and only ends up feathering it through to the keeper!
back of a length delivery on off stump that skids through. Parag swipes at it and misses as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the off side
four to start the over! Full and wide outside off stump. Parag gives it everything he has and scythes it over backward point!
off-pace delivery dug into the track on middle and leg stump. Padikkal swings a week early and swishes at thin air. That was not very far away from the stumps either
yorker outside off stump. Parag can't get under it and shanks it towards long on for one more run

just clears the fence! Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Parag has a swipe at it and miscues it badly. However, he has gotten just enough wood on it to clear the fielder at deep mid wicket!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Padikkal is again early into his stroke and flat-bats it towards long on for just a single
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Parag drops it into the off side and scampers across to the other end
full delivery just outside off stump. Padikkal does not pick the slower one for the umpteenth time and chalks it towards long off for a single
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Padikkal gives it everything he has and drags it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
four more! In the slot outside off stump. Padikkal sits deep in his crease and carves it over extra cover for another boundary!
length delivery outside off stump. This one skids through and Padikkal, backing away to access the off side, is beaten for pace
shot! Half-tracker outside off stump and Padikkal cashes in! He rocks back and pounds it past deep square leg for four! That very nearly cleared the fence!
edged and four! Length delivery angled into off stump. Padikkal backs away and throws his hands at it, getting a thick outside edge that races past short third man
slower delivery dug into the track way outside off stump. Padikkal advances, reaches out for it and toe-ends it towards extra cover. Would have been a wide had he left it
full delivery outside off stump. Parag gets onto the front foot and defends it towards backward point
length delivery on leg stump. Padikkal gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it towards short fine leg for a single
googly on a length outside off stump. Padikkal goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
short and wide outside off stump. Padikkal walks across his stumps and shovels it powerfully past long on for a much-needed boundary!
darted into the pads. Parag does not have any room to work with and can only flick it towards deep mid wicket for a single
short delivery outside off stump. Parag cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point
low full toss on leg stump. Parag lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
yorker just outside off stump. Parag jams his bat down in time and digs it out towards extra cover
back of a length delivery on off stump. Padikkal waits in his crease and cuts it towards deep cover point for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Parag chops it into the off side and gets off the mark
nearly! Slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Parag closes the bat face early and gets a leading edge that just evades Avesh

and he sends Hetmyer packing! Full delivery angled across the batter just outside off stump. Hetmyer looks to slog it over long on but is reaching out for it a shade. He is also slightly early into the stroke and toe-ends it towards long on, where Rahul does the rest! LSG are absolutely elated; RR sink further into trouble!
full delivery just outside off stump. Padikkal pushes it towards short extra cover
length delivery on leg stump. Hetmyer gets forward and nudges it towards deep mid wicket for a single
off-pace delivery on a length on leg stump. Padikkal waits in his crease and tucks it away towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery way down the leg side. Pooran does well to come around and get a glove to it. Called a wide, unsurprisingly

huge appeal, not given! LSG have no reviews left! Full delivery slanted into middle and leg stump. Hetmyer plays all over it and is rapped on the pads. The umpire says no, and replays suggest that it might have been going down leg
slower delivery on a full length on off stump. Padikkal does not pick it again and chips it off the inside half of the bat towards deep mid wicket
slower delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Padikkal presses forward and defends it back to the bowler
length delivery just outside off stump. Padikkal gets a half stride forward and dabs it towards backward point for one
length delivery angled into middle and leg stump. Hetmyer works it towards deep mid wicket and gets off the mark
full delivery just outside off stump. Hetmyer presses half forward and pokes it back to the bowler

holes out to deep mid wicket! Oh my! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that sticks in the surface just a shade. He tries to muscle it over deep mid wicket but does not get the power or the elevation he is after. Shanks it towards deep mid wicket, where Bishnoi does the rest!
full delivery outside off stump. Padikkal comes onto the front foot and punches it neatly towards deep cover point for one
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler guides it down to deep point for a single
edged! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler has a nibble at it and gets a thick outside edge that bobbles down to short third man
googly on a length outside off stump. Padikkal goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point to get off the mark

Samson has been run out! Oh dear! Length delivery angled into the stumps. Buttler turns it towards short fine leg, and then hesitates. Samson eventually decides to run through for the single and dives to make his ground. The throw, though, is accurate enough and catches Samson at least a yard short of his crease! Massive, massive moment in the game!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Buttler rocks onto the back foot and punches it crisply towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
length delivery slanted into leg stump. Samson does not seem to get bat on it as the ball deflects off the pads behind square
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler goes back and eases it towards deep cover point for a single
very full delivery angled into the stumps. Samson uses the pace and nudges it into the vast real estate on the leg side for a brace
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Samson swings too early and gets hit in an area where it usually hurts
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Samson gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point

taken at short third man! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal uses the pace and tries to guide it past short third man. He makes decent contact but hits it straight to Avesh, who swoops down low and completes the catch. He might have hurt his hand in the process, though, but LSG will not mind this breakthrough one bit!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal has a nibble at it but is beaten for pace as the ball fizzes past the bat
in the slot and that flies into the stands! Jaiswal opens up his stance just enough and deposits it over the deep mid wicket fence!
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Jaiswal knocks it down the ground for one more run
googly on a length outside off stump. Jaiswal hangs back and pokes it into the off side

safe! Length delivery on leg stump. Buttler glances it straight to short fine leg, and Jaiswal is again intent on the single. Avesh fires a throw at the batter's end and misses. Jaiswal might have been short had Avesh hit, despite the dive!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal goes back and punches it down the ground for a single
appeal! Full delivery just outside off stump. Buttler tries to repeat the stroke but does not make contact. The ball strikes the pad and Mishra appeals but the umpire says no
finds the gap again! Looped up on a full length outside off stump. Buttler brings out the reverse and razes it past backward point

googly on a full length on off stump. Buttler squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg, and Jaiswal calls him through. The fielder picks up cleanly and fires it at the bowler's end. It could have been interesting had he thrown at Jaiswal's end
full delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal gets down on one knee and drags it towards deep backward square leg
googly on a length on middle and off stump. Buttler goes deep into his crease and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal flicks it towards deep mid wicket for one more run
full delivery well outside off stump. Buttler throws his hands at it and misses. Pooran cannot gather either and Jaiswal sneaks in a bye
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler goes back and defends into the off side
length delivery just outside off stump. Buttler waits in his crease and punches it off the back foot towards deep cover point for a single
length delivery on leg stump. Jaiswal gets forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
full delivery outside off stump. Buttler comes forward and drives it towards extra cover, where Rahul does well to dive low and field it
shot! Loopy low full toss outside off stump. Buttler unfurls the reverse sweep and bisects the gap between short third man and backward point to perfection!
full delivery hung outside off stump. Buttler reaches out for it and clinks it towards extra cover
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal stretches forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal cuts it towards backward point, where Badoni misfields and lets the batters get across for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler hangs back and jabs it towards deep cover point for another single
full delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal lunges forward and pushes it towards long on for one

huge appeal, not given! Full delivery that might or might not have pitched outside leg. Jaiswal tries the reverse and misses, getting rapped on the front pad in the process. The umpire says no but Bishnoi manages to convince his skipper to review! This could come down to where the ball pitched. No bat involved, but the ball pitched well outside leg stump! Jaiswal survives!
back of a length delivery fired into off stump. Buttler backs away and slaps it towards long off for a single
shot! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Buttler waits in his crease and times it exquisitely past extra cover for four. And to add to Bishnoi's misery, he has overstepped!
length delivery at the stumps. Jaiswal shuffles across a little and flicks it down the ground for one
back of a length delivery on off stump. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and knocks it towards long on for one more run
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler takes a step down the track and works it into the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler dabs at it but can't beat the fielder at backward point
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Jaiswal eases it towards long on for a single
back of a length delivery angled into the batter. Jaiswal has a waft at it but does not get the purchase he is after
back of a length delivery on off stump. Jaiswal gets behind the line of the ball and taps it towards short extra cover
gets it through! Short, wide and this time, Buttler pounces! He delays his stroke long enough and knives it past backward point for four!
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Buttler advances and slices it straight to backward point
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal dabs it into the off side and calls Buttler through for a relatively sharp single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal looks for the cute, little dab but does not make any contact

bursts through the hands! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal flashes his blade at it and the ball flies off the outside edge towards short third man. Naveen, though, is beaten for pace and can't wrap his hands around it!
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal gets onto the front foot and crashes it between mid off and extra cover for four!
length delivery outside off stump that leaves the batter just a shade. Buttler goes chasing after it but can't get bat on it
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler has a bit of a wild hack at it and shanks it towards mid wicket

breaks the shackles! And it is outta here! In the slot on leg stump, and that is just what Buttler is waiting for! He opens up his stance and clatters it a mile over the deep mid wicket fence! That went a 112 metres!
full delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal drills it towards cover point, where the fielder misfields and concedes a single

Has Yudhvir hurt himself there? Very full delivery at the stumps. Jaiswal drives it straight back at the bowler, who picks it up cleanly. But then, while trying to throw it at the batter, he rolls his left ankle over
oh dear! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jaiswal dabs it towards backward point, where Mayers lets it go through his legs
full delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal tips it down the ground and hares across to the other end
length delivery in the channel just outside off stump. Jaiswal has a nibble at it and sees the ball cut past the outside edge. That might have been a leg-cutter
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler throws his hands at it but chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
length delivery outside off stump. Buttler takes a step down the track but can't beat the fielder at extra cover again
back of a length delivery on off stump. Buttler is cramped for room again and pats it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Buttler gets up on his toes and defends it towards backward point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Buttler gets up on his toes and guides it towards deep cover point for a single
off-pace delivery on a length just outside off stump. Buttler comes forward and punches it towards extra cover
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. Buttler is a tad early into the stroke and pushes it towards extra cover
full delivery hung outside off stump. Buttler goes fishing at it again and misses
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
full and angled into middle and leg stump. Buttler works it into the leg side and canters across to the other end
and he gets put away for six! Fractionally short on off stump. Jaiswal picks up the length early and dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!
shot! Full delivery on middle and off stump. Jaiswal plants his front foot, gets his hands through the ball and cracks it past mid off for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Buttler does not get bat on it as the ball trickles off the thigh pad into the leg side
full delivery slanted into the stumps. Buttler gets forward and flicks it towards mid on
length delivery just outside off stump. Buttler presses forward and pokes it into the off side
oh dear! Length delivery fired way down the leg side. Buttler lets it go and the keeper can't get anywhere close to it! Five extras added to RR's total!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that leaves the batter. Buttler has a fish at it away from his body and is beaten on the outside
slower delivery on a full length just outside off stump. Jaiswal comes onto the front foot and scuffs it towards mid off
low full toss on off stump. Jaiswal takes a step down the track and taps it towards mid off
slower delivery on a back of a length just outside off stump. Jaiswal goes back and runs it down to short third man
length delivery angled into the batter outside off stump. Buttler presses half forward and punches it into the off side to get off the mark
full delivery just outside off stump. Jaiswal comes forward and pushes it down the ground before haring across to the other end

huge appeal, not given! Was there bat involved? Full and angled into middle and off stump. Jaiswal falls over and then plays all around it as the ball thuds into the pads. LSG deliberate, and then review! If Jaiswal did not hit it, this could be very close. A slight spike as the ball is close to the bat, and Jaiswal survives!
